mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) has antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties that may potentiate bleeding risk when combined with tranylcypromine's known effects on hemostasis; additionally, turmeric may have weak MAOI-like or serotonergic activity raising theoretical serotonin syndrome risk.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding and serotonergic effects; consider advising patients on tranylcypromine to limit turmeric supplementation or use with caution and medical supervision.
